name: wonder
description: Create and edit designs with Codex on a canvas where every design is real code.

interface.shortDescription: Create and edit designs with Codex on a canvas where every design is real code.
interface.longDescription: Wonder connects Codex to a canvas where every design is real code. Codex can inspect existing designs, components, variables, and documentation, create new screens and flows, and edit designs in place. It works with the actual HTML and CSS structure instead of screenshots, so you can design from your codebase and move approved designs back into production without rebuilding them.
